answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 36145 Country: India Title: I want to know the meaning of following names for my baby child Question: I want to know the meaning of following names for my baby child: Hameed Rifaan, Hameed Hanoon and Hameed Rafaan. Please give your valuable suggestion. Answer ID: 36145 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 186/132/D=1433) Hameed means: desirable, praiseworthy Rifan means: drizzling, rain dropping Hanoon means: kind, affectionate Now you can find out the meaning of their combination. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
